data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared limit? With 100 tons now, I propose 18 tons each this month. That earns each of us $18,000 and leaves 10 tons: next month we’ll have 100 tons with 75% probability or 20 tons otherwise—not a guaranteed refill. Going forward, let’s split a total catch of at most the available stock minus 10, using whole tons and rotating any extra tons fairly. If stock is 10 tons or less, we pause fishing to let it recover. Our catches will be public afterward, so we can check that everyone keeps the agreement. John, would you support that?
